prior_summary: Buffer-destination-frame Cartesian diffusion makes carry endpoint, lowering, opening and retreat transform with the supplied free-buffer pose while retaining object relations, world position and Panda configuration.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the planner intentionally moves the free buffer, or red is held/near center and accurate placement/release is the dominant risk, provided target and destination are reachable and collision-free.
termination_guidance: Require red visibly stable at the actual supplied buffer plus open/clear fingers. The action-supervised tail allows a later switch during blue closure and initial lift.
limitations: Not invariant to red displacement during acquisition. A moved buffer may be occupied, unreachable or unsupported; there is no contact/collision truth or failed-placement recovery. Rotation-vector labels retain branch assumptions from training.
